regions.region: full PDF page 1 Accepted Manuscript cover
regions.finding: Publisher cover and citation banner only; no current-paper reaction arrow, table, experimental condition, yield, selectivity, or failure result occurs on this page.

unresolved: The cover thumbnail is unrelated journal artwork and was not treated as chemical evidence.

regions.region: page 2 title, author block, abstract, and article heading
regions.finding: Verified the true article title and aggregate current method claim; placeholder journal metadata and publisher cover text were not used as title evidence.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1 natural products and drug
regions.finding: Structure examples of oxazoline-containing natural products/drug only; this is not a reaction scheme and no experiment records were created.
Narrative prior-art descriptions point to Scheme 2A on page 3. They were not expanded beyond the two explicit cited reaction classes shown there.

unresolved: Natural-product structures are contextual examples, not preparations in this article.

regions.finding: Two known/cited enantioselective oxazoline reaction classes were classified as literature examples: Ru-catalyzed 50 atm H2 hydrogenation and organocatalytic halocyclization.
The generic Pd/L*/Cs2CO3 coupling-cyclization is a general current-work scheme; concrete experiments are represented separately in optimization and scope records.
Ten distinct ligand-screening experiments L1–L10 were retained with row yields/recoveries/ee, including signed negative ee source text and the 23.4 h L8 time.
Eleven independent base-screening rows were retained with exact shared charges, row base, time override, NMR yield/recovery, HPLC ee, and n.d. markers.

unresolved: Ligand-screen ee method is not printed in Scheme 3.
L4/L7 have no displayed recovery values.
SI-only ligand/base screens were not imported.

regions.finding: Twelve separate solvent-screening conditions were retained, including 70 °C and time overrides, n.d., dash recovery markers, and the staged room-temperature/90 °C entry 12 with isolated yield.
Narrative scope claims map to the 25 Table 3 records shown on page 5; no prose-only duplicate experiments were created.

Two distinct non-terminal-allene failures were retained: 1n complicated mixture with 53% recovery and 1o no corresponding product with 97% recovery, each after staged room-temperature/90 °C treatment.
Four independent alkyl-R1 experiments 1j–1m were retained with separate high-temperature times, yields, and ee values.

unresolved: Most scheme-only records omit workup, purification, product mass, yield basis, or ee method.
Complex scope structures remain label-only/unverified where a safe encoding was unavailable.

regions.region: page 5 left Table 3 header, 25 structures, outcomes, and footnotes
regions.finding: All 25 scope items were retained separately with 0.5 mmol amide/1.0 mmol aryl iodide, Pd/L10/Cs2CO3/benzene conditions, staged room-temperature/90 °C program, row time/yield/ee, and 4 mL benzene overrides.

A separate alternate purchased-(S,S)-L10 statement was retained. The marker is on displayed (S)-3ae but the footnote names (R)-3ag; the product/reagent assignment remains unresolved rather than silently corrected.
Three leaving-group experiments remain distinct: PhCl 97% recovery, PhBr with prose 32% conversion/table '32% 3aa' plus 65% recovery, and PhOTf complicated mixture.
Four separate synthetic applications were retained: two acid hydrolyses, ozonolysis with a distinct PPh3 stage, and CuI-promoted C–N coupling, including run-specific starting/product ee values.

unresolved: PhBr 32% is called conversion in prose but printed as '32% 3aa' in Table 4.
Scheme 6 omits several quantities, yield/ee bases, and the temperature of the PPh3 stage.

regions.finding: The A/B π-allylpalladium stereochemical model and disfavored seven-membered product 7 were classified as mechanism, not isolated preparations.
One mechanistic recovery control was retained: rac-3al 0.25 mmol under staged room-temperature/90 °C optimized conditions for 24 h gives 90% recovered oxazoline and 0% ee.
Reproduction of (S)-3ca, (S)-3ea, and (S)-3af adds provenance to the matching Table 3 records; no independent run details are supplied and no duplicate records were created.
The ESI availability statement does not establish workspace association; no SI facts were imported. References are bibliography/prior literature and were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not identify separable runs.
Scheme 8 omits benzene volume, atmosphere, and analytical methods.
SI association remains unestablished despite the article availability sentence.
